summary: XP Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 17, 2026, reporting its second-quarter 2026 financial results via a press release and earnings presentation. The filing contains routine operating and financial metrics, including client assets, net inflows, revenue, net income, and segment performance. There are no events indicating a special situation such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, or management change. The filing is a standard quarterly earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer and does not trigger any special-situations category.
